The [complete comparison](comparison-complete.csv) uses total pressure, Bülow Eq. 28 and the issue's ±3 percentage-point intervals. All 67 states qualify and all eight isotherms miss their intervals: **not reproduced under the declared interpretation**. This is numerical verification, not physical validation; global stability and uniqueness of the four roots were not checked. The interpretation was not changed. The remaining source and extrapolation limits below still apply.

## Original run: result and comparison

The fixed published parameters with classic Born and the literal, unnormalized
solvent mole-fraction permittivity give 63 qualified bubble states out of the
67 primary Kuranov 1996 Table 2 rows. Five complete isotherms fall outside the
predeclared intervals. Three isotherms have unresolved states, so their full
ARD is unavailable. Failed attempts remain in the required row counts; no
solved-subset ARD substitutes for the eight-isotherm comparison. The issue-223
verdict is **inconclusive**, pending numerical diagnosis and an owner decision.
This is partial numerical verification and fixed-parameter model evaluation,
not physical validation or evidence that the published model is infeasible.
Independent delivery review remains open; no manuscript promotion is requested.

Missing crosses identify unresolved comparisons. The intervals are not measurement uncertainties.](comparison.png)

The retained [comparison values](comparison.csv) use Bülow Eq. 28,
$100 N^{-1}\sum_i|1-P_i^{calc}/P_i^{obs}|$. References are Bülow 2021
SI Table S3 (PDF p. 2), main-paper Eq. 28 and Figure 4; Kuranov 1996
Table 2, printed p. 1960. All primary observations are **total** pressures;
$y_{CO_2}P$ and all vapor fractions are retained as diagnostics, with no
experimental partial pressure inferred.

## Numerical evidence and failures

On the 63 qualified states, maximum equilibrium residual is
7.352 × 10⁻¹³, maximum elemental balance error is 7.391 × 10⁻¹⁴ mol,
maximum phase-sum error is 2.221 × 10⁻¹⁶ and maximum relative pressure
replay difference is 2.080 × 10⁻¹². Charge balances pass 10⁻¹⁰ mol.
Liquid and vapor compositions are nonnegative, dielectric values are valid,
and both phases have positive pressure-density derivatives. All four
reaction-reference diagnostics report availability and converged density roots
for each qualified state. These checks establish local physical admissibility;
no global stability or unique-root claim is made.

| Source row | T / K | MDEA / mol kg⁻¹ | CO₂ / mol kg⁻¹ | Termination | Maximum equation residual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | 313.16 | 1.9938 | 2.6240 | Local infeasibility, 96 iterations | 1.00000038 |
| 18 | 333.15 | 1.9493 | 2.4433 | Budget exhausted, 200 iterations | 0.06156211 |
| 50 | 313.14 | 3.9707 | 4.4696 | Local infeasibility, 103 iterations | 0.06209167 |
| 51 | 313.15 | 3.9707 | 4.5950 | Budget exhausted, 200 iterations | 1.63035655 × 10⁷ |

Row 18 reports an invalid temperature/system-pressure trial reference; row 51
reports an invalid-composition polish trial. These messages identify numerical
stopping points, not the root cause. All rows use one independent
ideal-speciation seed inherited from issue 126, measured pressure as the initial
pressure guess, and default Engine work limits. No retries, added starts,
increased budgets or refitting have been used. The other 63 primary states
supply neighboring-state evidence but do not establish a correction for these
four cases. [Engine issue 912](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/issues/912)
requests diagnosis with these exact inputs and acceptance criteria.

Historical status at completion of the primary run: work paused before
altering the numerical method; sensitivities had not yet run. The two dielectric
sensitivities subsequently ran on the 63 qualified rows; see the
[pressure-gap diagnosis](diagnosis-gap/notebook.qmd). The
[second diagnosis round](diagnosis-round2/notebook.qmd) corrects Figure 4 and
reports the authorized convention probes. The zero-loading rows and alternative
69-row statistic remain unrun. The primary result remains inconclusive.

## Model, basis and provenance

The feed basis is 1 kg initial water, using each row's actual temperature and
MDEA/CO₂ molalities. Eight liquid species and three neutral vapor species use
Bülow Tables 1–3; four H⁺ reactions use the issue's corrected SI S1 assignment,
raw mole-fraction infinite-dilution-water reference and system pressure.
The [frozen declaration](declaration.json), [source identities](sources.json)
and [row inventory](inventory.json) remain unchanged.

The complete repeat checks pass on Engine
`d513820994a78bfe628d42fffd55b2eeab6f89bd`: Born reduction (native and Eq. 20
both −5.767776540963188), temperature laws, association, reaction constants,
admission and neutral/charged derivatives (maxima 2.599 × 10⁻⁹ and
2.609 × 10⁻⁹, limit 10⁻⁵). Native dielectric values 58 and 72.5 pass
10⁻¹² absolute, with density/mass independence, pure limits and charged
zero-solvent refusal. The document-diff assertion passes.

## Original run: meaning and limits

The five completed comparisons show disagreement under the declared reconstruction.
They do not resolve the overall reproduction verdict while four states remain
unqualified. The ±3-point intervals are a working allowance. The authors' exact
permittivity inputs, scored observable and row selection remain unknown. Hsieh's
MDEA law above 328.15 K and water at 393 K are extrapolations; the MDEA reaction
law above 368 K is also extrapolated. H⁺ bookkeeping and the printed association
volumes remain frozen interpretations. Nothing here supports parameter adoption,
transferability, process use, or a claim of error in the publication.
